content: {"praised":["Beautiful music and photography enhance the film's visual appeal.","Fast pacing keeps teenagers engaged and reduces boredom.","Omar Sharif delivers a compelling, intense portrayal of Peter.","Less stodgy than older biblical films, more accessible.","Depth and breadth of RAI production impresses viewers."],"criticized":["Audio and subtitles frequently out of sync with dialogue.","Acting and dubbing lack emotion and contain mispronunciations.","Film-making quality low, technical issues abound.","Biblical events altered, causing inaccuracies for knowledgeable viewers.","Poor delivery and lack of emotional resonance."]}
